title: Perfectly sized bowls
text: Perfectly sized bowls. These bowls are beautiful and perfect for my morning oatmeal cooked in the microwave!! Other bowls boiled over and made a huge mess!  Fantastic bowls for the price!

product_metadata.title: DOWAN White Cereal Bowls - 31 Ounces Porcelain Large Cereal and Soup Bowl, Non-slip Bottom, Chip Resistant, Dishwasher Microwave Safe Bowl for Ice Cream, Pasta, Oatmeal, Fluted Bowl Set of 4
features: Deep and Spill-proof Bowl Sets. Maximum capacity 31oz (3.3in) is deep and large enough for soup, cereal, pasta, morning oatmeal, ice cream, salad, chili, fruit, breakfast, restaurant serving and party sauce.

Stylish Fluted Design for Easy Holding. The fluted side makes it easier to hold HOT and COLD items in your hands. These cereal bowls adds a stylistic touch to your table and brightens up your mornings.

Non-slip and Cooling Bottom. The bumping design in the bottom prevents sliding on the table or countertop. Also this ventilation design does no harm to your table especially when holding extremely hot food.

Healthy and Durable Top Grade Porcelain. No harmful plastics, cadmium or Lead. Microwave, oven, refrigerator and dishwasher safe. The long-lasting ceramics blocks moisture absorption and prevents cracking.

Stylish Gift with ZERO Risk. This special white bowls are perfect for your family members, friends or neighbors. They will surely love them. Dowan will offer a free replacement or refund if anything goes wrong with the soup bowls.
